# tasks.spot_detection { #operetta_compose.tasks.spot_detection }

`tasks.spot_detection`

Detect spots with Spotiflow and count them per segmented object.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [count_spots_per_label](#operetta_compose.tasks.spot_detection.count_spots_per_label) | Assign detected spots to labels and count the spots per label. |
| [spot_detection](#operetta_compose.tasks.spot_detection.spot_detection) | Detect spots with Spotiflow and count them per segmented object. |

### count_spots_per_label { #operetta_compose.tasks.spot_detection.count_spots_per_label }

```python
tasks.spot_detection.count_spots_per_label(points, label_array)
```

Assign detected spots to labels and count the spots per label.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type       | Description                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|-------------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| points      | np.ndarray | Spot coordinates with shape ``(n_spots, ndim)`` in the same axis order as ``label_array`` (e.g. ``(y, x)`` for a 2D label image). | _required_ |
| label_array | np.ndarray | Integer label image where ``0`` marks the background.                                                                             | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                              |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | A dataframe indexed by ``label`` with a single ``spot_count`` column.    |
|        | pd.DataFrame | Every non-background label is represented, with a count of ``0`` when no |
|        | pd.DataFrame | spot was assigned to it. Spots that fall on the background are ignored.  |

### spot_detection { #operetta_compose.tasks.spot_detection.spot_detection }

```python
tasks.spot_detection.spot_detection(
    zarr_url,
    channel_name,
    label_image_name,
    roi_table_name='FOV_ROI_table',
    model_name='general',
    output_table_name='spots',
    overwrite=True,
)
```

Detect spots with Spotiflow and count them per segmented object.

For every ROI in ``roi_table_name`` the selected channel is run through a
pretrained Spotiflow model. Each detected spot is assigned to the label it
falls on and the per-label spot counts are written back as a feature table.

Requires the optional ``spotiflow`` dependency (``pip install
"operetta-compose[spotiflow]"``).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type   | Description                                         | Default           |
|-------------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| zarr_url          | str    | Path to an OME-Zarr image (provided by Fractal).    | _required_        |
| channel_name      | str    | Name of the channel to detect spots in.             | _required_        |
| label_image_name  | str    | Name of the label image the spots are counted over. | _required_        |
| roi_table_name    | str    | Name of the ROI table to iterate over.              | `'FOV_ROI_table'` |
| model_name        | str    | Name of the pretrained Spotiflow model to use.      | `'general'`       |
| output_table_name | str    | Name of the feature table to write.                 | `'spots'`         |
| overwrite         | bool   | Whether to overwrite an existing output table.      | `True`            |
